Chapter 29

Chapter 29: Teacher Tiantian Asks Lin Fan to Come On Stage

[Name: Lin Fan]

[Level: LV4]

[Level 4 reward: 10 yuan for every breath; 10 yuan for every second of sleep; 10 yuan for every step taken. Rewards are distributed at 12 a.m. daily.]

[Upgrade cost: 2.97 million/10 million (not including gifts and gambling. In addition, all items obtained from the system are prohibited from being traded.]

[Skills: Professional Driving Skills, Charming Aura (5% chance to trigger love at first sight and unforgettable love), Violent Aesthetics, Drinking Gentleman, Absolute Focus (5% chance to trigger a flash of inspiration), Professor-Level Mathematics Experience, Eyes of Truth, Professional Basketball Technique, Pianist-Level Performance.]

[Funds: 11.5 million.]

Lin Fan looked at the system’s list, then closed his eyes and fell into a deep sleep.

…

The next day, a warm ray of the morning sun shone through the window and into Dorm 104.

Ring, ring, ring.

Almost at the same time, three different bells rang in the dormitory.

Ma Zhong, Song Yi, and Zheng Jinbao, who were originally sleeping soundly, sat up from the bed together and quickly put on their clothes.

“What’s wrong with you guys?” Lin Fan asked.

Yesterday, they took a long time before they got up unwillingly.

Today, they were like completely different people.

“It’s teacher Tiantian’s class! It’s teacher Tiantian’s class!” Zheng Jinbao shouted.

Lin Fan was still puzzled, but he still washed up and got dressed.

On the way to the classroom, Lin Fan saw the three of them walking anxiously and asked, “Is Teacher Tiantian’s class very important?”

“It’s important! It’s too important! I feel uncomfortable if I go without seeing Teacher Tiantian for a day!” Zheng Jinbao said.

“Brother Fan, let’s go!” Song Yi said. “Otherwise, there won’t be any seats left later.”

No seats?

The university classrooms were very spacious.

Lin Fan had been going to classes for the past two days, and there were many empty seats in the classroom each time.

Would there be no seats today?

Lin Fan was filled with questions as he finally arrived at the classroom.

It was only now that he understood why Song Yi and the others had said that.

There were still more than ten minutes before class started.

However, the classroom was already filled with people.

Zheng Jinbao pointed to the last row and said excitedly, “There are still four seats left. Let’s go. Let’s hurry over. Don’t let anyone else take them.”

When Lin Fan and the others sat down, all the seats were filled.

Those who entered the classroom now could only sigh helplessly and leave after seeing the seating arrangement.

“Why are there so many people in this teacher’s class?” Lin Fan asked.

“You’ll know later,” Song Yi said excitedly.

Ring!

At this moment, the school bell rang.

In an instant, the originally chaotic classroom became as quiet as a pin drop.

Step, step, step.

A series of crisp footsteps approached from afar.

Soon, a beautiful woman walked to the podium.

She had long hair that fell like a waterfall, and on her delicate face, she had willow-leaf eyebrows, slender eyes, a small nose, and a cherry-like mouth.

She was wearing a white dress that outlined her perfect body.

In addition, she exuded a special charm that made people unable to move their heads away from her.

Lin Fan could not help but use his Eyes of Truth to observe her.

[Appearance: 98 ]

[Favorability: 60 ]

A face value of 98!

It was close to full marks!

Perhaps all the classic poems were about her.

It was no wonder that his classmates were in such a hurry to attend her class.

A favorability score of 60? He had reached the passing line of 60 points! She seemed to have a good impression of him!

Could it be that she was a teacher who treated every student as a friend?

At this moment, Hu Tian, who was standing on the podium, said, “Today, we’ll continue the lesson on advanced algebra.”

Her voice was as sweet and magnetic as her name, making people not want to miss a single word.

After a while, Hu Tian wrote a question on the blackboard. [Find all the prime numbers P, Q, R, and make p^q+p^r a completely square number.]

“Everyone can try to answer it,” Hu Tian said.

All the students immediately picked up their pens and began to write on the draft paper.

They wanted to use the shortest amount of time to solve the problem and gain Hu Tian’s attention.

However, very quickly, all the students started to scratch their ears and cheeks.

They did not know how to answer.

“Ma Zhong, you still haven’t answered it?” Zheng Jinbao anxiously asked. “It’s already been so long!”

“Don’t be anxious!” Ma Zhong said.

“Don’t let anyone beat you to it! If you can’t answer it, then I hope that no one else can!” Song Yi silently prayed.

Hu Tian’s eyes were as bright as water as she scanned the classroom as if she was looking for someone who could answer the questions.

Unfortunately, no one raised their hands to answer the question.

“Lin Fan, can you come over and answer the question?” Hu Tian asked.

Lin Fan stood up slowly.

Instantly, all the students ‘gazes fell on Lin Fan.

Their gazes were full of envy and jealousy!

Lin Fan did not understand why Hu Tian would suddenly call him out.

‘I didn’t raise my hand, did I?’

Lin Fan first looked at the question on the blackboard and thought for a moment. Then, he walked to the podium and picked up the chalk to write quickly.

[If Q=r, then p^q+p^r=2p^q. Therefore, p=2, and Q is a prime number.]

[Therefore,(2, Q, Q) is the group of three prime numbers that meets the conditions]

…

[In summary:

[(2,2,5),(2,5,2);]

[(3,2,3),(3,3,2);]

[(2,q,q),(q”=3)]

Soon, a large number of equations were written on the blackboard, and the answer was finally obtained.

“Yes,” Hu Tian nodded and said. “The answer is correct. Moreover, it’s even simpler than the calculation method I thought of.”

“But, this is still not the easiest way to solve the problem,” Lin Fan said.

“Oh?” Hu Tian’s interest was piqued.

Then, under Hu Tian’s expectant gaze, Lin Fan wrote down the steps to solve the problem, which was almost simplified by half.

When Hu Tian saw this, her beautiful eyes brightened as she exclaimed in admiration, “I didn’t expect prime numbers to be calculated like this.”

After a moment of silence, Hu Tian said, “If we use this method, perhaps…”

Hu Tian could not help but quickly write on the blackboard.

[Q=p1m1+b1=p2m2+b2…pkmk+bk]

[Q=41=2m+1=3m+2=5m+1]

…

Not long after, Hu Tian stopped writing.

Then, she looked at Lin Fan with a gaze that was seeking help.

“Twin Prime Number Conjecture?” Lin Fan asked.

Ever since he received Professor-Level Mathematics Experience, he had a lot of mathematics-related information in his brain. Of course, he knew about the world-class problem, the Twin Prime Number Conjecture.

“Yes.” Hu Tian nodded.

Lin Fan picked up a piece of chalk and quickly wrote down something below Hu Tian’s formulas.

However, even with Lin Fan’s Professor-Level Mathematics Experience and Absolute Focus, if he couldn’t trigger the 5% flash of inspiration, he wouldn’t be able to solve the Twin Prime Conjecture.

After a while, Lin Fan also stopped.

“What do you think of the above calculations if we change it to p^q+ QB = 3m +2?”

Lin Fan thought for a moment and shook his head. “No, let’s change it to 5P5m +p^q.”

The two of them discussed as they wrote down the steps to solve the problem.

Very soon, the entire blackboard was filled with densely packed calculations.
